name: Git Branch Cleanup
description: List and delete local branches that have already been merged into the default branch.

dry_run.description: If true, only list branches that would be deleted without actually deleting them

steps.description: List all local branches that have been merged into the default branch
Delete the merged branches (skipped if dry_run is true)

constraints: Never delete the default branch (main, master, or configured default)
Only branches fully merged into HEAD are eligible for deletion
Preview the list of branches before any deletion occurs
invariants: No unmerged branch is ever deleted
Default branch is always preserved regardless of input
Dry run mode never modifies any branch state
